text:
Situation: Nitroglycerin 0.4 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 74 tablets at 13.2 per day (5.6 days supply). Corvale General holds 198 tablets at 14.2 per day (14 days supply). Corvale Lakeside holds 24 tablets at 3.8 per day (6.3 days supply). The current product label lists A-S Medication Solutions as the registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-08-12.

Why (FDA record): FDA’s drug shortage list does not include nitroglycerin as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply at East and Lakeside is below two weeks. General has adequate stock. No national shortage is declared. Alternative manufacturers are available but their labels do not identify a registered plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place immediate orders for Advagen Pharma Ltd product for East and Lakeside; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Aurobindo Pharma Limited as secondary source; requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Dr. Reddys Laboratories Inc as tertiary source; requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
4. Buyer to qualify Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Inc., USA as quaternary source; requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
5. Buyer to qualify Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. as fifth source; requires buyer and quality assurance approval.
6. Pharmacy director to approve inter-facility transfer from General to East and Lakeside if needed; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending a national shortage declaration. Changing clinical protocols without committee review.
